articles.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
articles.snippet: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets bounce from big early declines
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% plunge to just a modest loss, with Michael Burry announcing he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.

articles.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
articles.snippet: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

articles.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
articles.snippet: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

articles.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
articles.snippet: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.
